intro: Answer 5 quick questions and get a 30-day plan with your track and hours filled in: one specific task a day and the exact portal tool for it. 100% no-cost.
shapedBy: One proven 30-day sequence. Your track fills in the niche days, your hours set the pace note, and your equipment and language answers adjust the days that depend on them.

paceNotes.1-2: At 1–2 hours a day, do the day's task and stop. Carry anything unfinished to the next day instead of skipping it.
paceNotes.2-3: At 2–3 hours a day, one task a day is the pace this plan was written for.
paceNotes.4+: At 4+ hours a day, finish the day's task, then spend the rest of the block inside the linked tool. Do not pull tomorrow's task forward.

weeks.title: Foundation & Setup
weeks.focus: Get your setup, mindset, and core skills right.

days.task: Confirm equipment & workspace with the Equipment Checker.

alt.equipment:partial: Run the Equipment Checker. List the one or two things still missing, with a price next to each.
alt.equipment:none: Run the Equipment Checker. List what you still need, with a price next to each, and a date you can afford it.

days.task: Read the full roadmap end to end. Note which stage you are in today.
Run the learn-any-tool method on Google Sheets: one real artifact in the first hour.
Explore niches. Shortlist your top two directions.
days.forTrack: Read the {track} niche page end to end. Note its tools, certifications, and who hires.

days.task: Open Build Labs. Learn the anatomy of a resume, don't write it yet.
Practice: complete one small micro-task in your chosen niche.
Review week 1. Rest. Write down why you started.

weeks.title: Build Your Assets
weeks.focus: Create the profile, resume, and portfolio that get replies.

days.task: Find 5 real resumes for your target role. Extract the rules they share.
days.forTrack: Find 5 real {track} resumes. Extract the rules they share.

days.task: Write your resume from those rules, on a blank page. It's yours.
Write your own prompt to critique it, learn the anatomy of a prompt.
Learn your niche's #1 tool to a working level.
days.forTrack: Learn {tool} to a working level. It is the #1 tool on the {track} niche page.

days.task: Start a no-cost certification for your niche.
days.forTrack: Pick the {track} certification you will start. The niche page lists them; {cert} is first.

days.task: Build your own application tracker, schema and formulas, from scratch.
Review your first two weeks on your dashboard. Write down what you shipped, what you skipped, and why.

weeks.title: Apply Relentlessly
weeks.focus: Work the directory. Track everything. Prep to interview.

days.task: Open the Apply directory. Shortlist 20 places to apply.
Send 5 tailored applications using a message prompt you wrote in the workshop.
Send 5 more. Log each in your tracker.
Run a mock interview against an interviewer prompt you build yourself.
Send 5 more applications. Follow up on day-1 sends.
Learn the negotiation basics. Set your target rate.
Review pipeline. Adjust your message based on replies.

weeks.title: Interview, Close & Deliver
weeks.focus: Convert interviews, land the offer, and start strong.

days.task: Send 10 applications. Quality over speed.
Run 2 full mock interviews against your own interviewer prompt. Debrief each with AI.
Handle any rejection: extract the lesson, keep going.
Rehearse your negotiation script out loud until it sounds like you.
Prep your first-week onboarding kit.
Write the SOPs and build the trackers your new role needs.
Deliver a proactive first update. Impress early.
Plan your niche + language path for months 2–3.

days.task: Review the full month on your dashboard. Share what worked, and pull the next person up.
